xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. These unaudited consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (IND-AS) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act.2013 and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

2. The above unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and period ended 30th September 2026 in respect of Diffusion Engineers Limited have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their respective meetings held on 4th November 2026. The Statutory auditors have expressed unmodified opinion on financial results for the quarter and period ended 30th September 2026.

3. The unaudited consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30the September 2026 is the balancing figures between unaudited consolidated figures in respect of the quarter ended 30th June 2026 and period year ended 30th September, 2026. The figures for the year ended 31st March, 2026 are extracted from the audited Financials Statement of that period.

4. As a result of the Management review mechanism, the Company has one segment “Welding Fabrication Technology and Engineering” which includes Manufacturing, Trading and Job Work.

5. During the quarter and period ended 30th September, 2026 the Company has received dividend of USD 5,00,000 from its wholly owned subsidiary - Diffusion Engineers Singapore Pte. Ltd., which has been eliminated while consolidating the above financial result as per IND- AS 110.

6. Exceptional item in the year ended 31st March, 2026
On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the New Labour Codes, rationalizing employee benefit definitions. The Group has assessed the financial impact and, considering its materiality and non-recurring nature, recognized the one-time impact primarily on long-term benefits (gratuity and compensated absences) as an exceptional item in the financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026. The Group continues to monitor further developments.

7. The Company has instituted the Diffusion Engineers Limited – Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025, approved by shareholders on June 29, 2025, for issuing up to 7,00,000 options via the Diffusion ESOP Trust. On December 25, 2025, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved a grant of 3,00,000 options at Rs.325 per option (face value Rs.10), of which 1,00,000 options were accepted by eligible employees on December 27, 2025. These options vest in four equal tranches of 25% each subject to vesting conditions, and the Trust holds 3,00,000 equity shares acquired through secondary market acquisition funded by a company loan.

The fair value of stock options (at grant date) is recognised as an expense in the Statement of Profit and Loss within employee benefits as employee compensation cost over the vesting period, with a corresponding increase in ESOP Reserve (a component of equity). Dividend received by the Trust has been recognised in ESOP Reserve.

The Company’s equity shares held by a trust, which is consolidated as a part of the Company, are classified as Treasury shares. Treasury shares are carried at acquisition cost and presented as a deduction from total equity as “Treasury share reserve”

8. The figures of previous periods / year are reclassified, regrouped and rearranged wherever necessary so as to make them comparable with current period's figures.
